title: hieracium planchonianum subsp. aveyronense
intro: Hieracium planchonianum subsp. aveyronense, commonly known as Aveyron hawkweed, is a plant species within the dandelion-like genus Hieracium. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium planchonianum subsp. aveyronense include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and potential antimicrobial agent, making it a promising candidate for the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as quercetin, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
